options.name: col
options.description: Identifies the column in the record.

options.name: database_socket
options.description: Path/ip to datbase socket to use Default path is used if not specified Path should start with 'unix:' prefix

options.name: key
options.description: Identifies the key in the record column, when the column is a map type.

options.name: record
options.description: Identifies the record in the table.

options.name: state
options.description: Configures the state of the key. When set to I(present), the I(key) and I(value) pair will be set on the I(record) and when set to I(absent) the I(key) will not be set.

options.name: table
options.description: Identifies the table in the database.

options.name: timeout
options.description: How long to wait for ovs-vswitchd to respond

options.name: value
options.description: Expected value for the table, record, column and key.
